description: Formal axioms, inference rules, and claim templates for tax compliance. Covers deduction validity, filing status, withholding, and liability estimates. Jurisdiction-parameterized.

axioms.statement: A deduction is eligible if and only if the underlying expense satisfies all statutory conditions for the relevant jurisdiction and tax year, and is supported by adequate documentation.
A taxpayer can hold exactly one filing status for a given tax year. Filing statuses are mutually exclusive.
Withholding is correct if the amount withheld matches the liability computed under the applicable withholding tables for the taxpayer's elections.
All income from all sources reportable under the applicable jurisdiction's law must be included in the tax return.

claim_templates.description: Assert that a specific deduction is valid for the taxpayer for the tax year.
Assert the correct filing status for a taxpayer for a tax year.
Assert an estimated tax liability for a taxpayer for a period.

consistency_constraints.description: Cannot simultaneously hold two different filing statuses for the same taxpayer and tax year.
Cannot simultaneously hold a claim of deduction_valid and deduction_invalid for the same expense.
